top_3_failure_patterns.description: Form 1040 transfers totals across multiple lines (e.g. line 1a -> line 1z; line 16 -> line 18 -> line 22 -> line 24). When identical dollar figures appear on multiple rows, the unguided extractor collapses citations to a single row, failing the other rows.
top_3_failure_patterns.mechanical_fix: Anchor each schema field to its specific line-number y-band (y in [anchor_y - 0.008, anchor_y + 0.008]), forcing candidate selection onto the correct row.

top_3_failure_patterns.description: Core tax numbers (Adjusted Gross Income, Total Income, Taxable Refunds) recur on subsequent supporting schedules (Schedule 1, Schedule A/B/D, Form 8995, state tax forms). The extractor drifts to later pages (e.g. page 24) instead of grounding to the primary Form 1040 page (page 1 or 2).
top_3_failure_patterns.mechanical_fix: Restrict line item candidates for Form 1040 schema fields to Page 1 (lines 1-15) and Page 2 (lines 16-38), falling back to Schedule 1 (Page 3-4) only for schedule_1 prefixed fields.

top_3_failure_patterns.description: Fields are completely omitted by the baseline pipeline because the generic token search fails to localize the line item value box within dense tabular OCR text.
top_3_failure_patterns.mechanical_fix: Extract values directly from the localized right-rail bounding box (x in [0.75, 0.95]) aligned vertically with the detected line anchor.
